threads.subject: Work inquiry from google.
body: Hello, This is Jenny from google. We're the largest online platform offering contractor opportunities worldwide.
We reviewed your company profile and would like to discuss a partnership on our upcoming infrastructure tenders.
Please find the project details attached and let us know a suitable time for a call.

threads.subject: Account Manager.
body: Hello, Greeting from Uber. Hope you doing great. I am approaching to you for as our company need a great & talented account manager.
What we need from you to start: Your CV, Verified Gov ID
After that we need to redesign our landing page because the current one does not carry any information. If you have any question don't hesitate to contact us.
